title: Concept History
description: The documented history of one concept in a survey: each formulation and the criticism recorded against it, every entry anchored by a quote to a source record. concept-history-check validates the anchors, the dates, and the entry rule, and computes the rank.

concept.description: Name of the concept, as the report uses it.

area.description: The scope area of the brief that owns the concept.

current_formulation.description: One sentence on the latest formulation the records show.

steps.description: Formulations in date order. Each step is one new formulation, never a criticism, comparison, evaluation, or application.

formulation.description: What this formulation proposed, in one or two sentences.

date.description: Date of the formulation: the publication_date of its record, or its relevant_event_date when the record describes an earlier event.

record.description: ID of the source record that documents the formulation, such as A2-SR-05.

quote.description: A contiguous passage copied word for word from one double-quoted passage of the record's Evidence section. No ellipsis.

criticism.description: The criticism recorded against this formulation, or null when no record documents one.

record.description: ID of the source record that documents the criticism.

date.description: Date of the criticism: the publication_date of its record, or its relevant_event_date when the record describes an earlier event.

quote.description: A contiguous passage copied word for word from one double-quoted passage of the record's Evidence section. No ellipsis.

drove_next.description: True when the report claims this criticism led to the next formulation. The check then requires the criticism to be dated no later than the next step.
